narrative: This week pushes the secret-exfiltration threat back into the foreground: the NSA ranks tool-poisoning highest-severity because malicious server metadata reaches the agent with instruction-level authority, and Bleeding Llama (CVE-2026-7482) lets an unauthenticated attacker leak API keys and system prompts from 300,000-plus exposed Ollama servers - the canonical indirect-injection-to-leak path. The named category still has not topped a formal list, though.
remaining_gap: No CIS or OWASP risk list yet ranks an "Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration" category at the top; today is CVEs and government design guidance, not a list entry.
